novel_features.name: Local Intelligence Store
novel_features.description: Persistent SQLite cache with FTS5 full-text search across all IOCs and relationship tracking for graph workflows
novel_features.novelty_claim: No existing VirusTotal CLI (official or community) offers persistent local storage with full-text search and relationship graph

novel_features.name: Pivot Workflows
novel_features.description: BFS graph traversal across IOC relationships (file→domain→IP→file chains) with cycle detection and Mermaid diagram output
novel_features.novelty_claim: Official VirusTotal CLI does not support graph traversal. Community CLIs support only direct relationships, not multi-hop pivoting.

novel_features.name: Batch IOC Enrichment Pipeline
novel_features.description: Concurrent batch processor with auto-type detection, worker pool, progress tracking, and structured summary report
novel_features.novelty_claim: No existing VirusTotal CLI offers batch processing with auto-detection and concurrency management

novel_features.name: LLM-Native Output
novel_features.description: --llm flag restructures JSON responses with natural language summaries, threat context, and tool-calling suggestions optimized for LLM consumption
novel_features.novelty_claim: No existing VirusTotal CLI offers LLM-optimized output format

novel_features.name: Threat Detection Diff
novel_features.description: Compares detection results between two scans to surface vendor disagreements, new detections, and classification changes
novel_features.novelty_claim: No existing VirusTotal CLI offers detection comparison between scans
